meta.description: Absolute slabs create extremely pure and intense surfaces, made even more attractive and deep by their impressive grain, as fine as stardust. Their unquestionable elegance enhances every space, from kitchen and bathroom counters to facing and flooring.

The light background of the Top Crystal quartz agglomerate slab is dotted with alternating fine-grain and medium-grain quartz in various natural colours, with occasional translucent glimmers of light. This timeless style enhances all kinds of contexts.

Black always conveys character, style, elegance. The black of the Top Crystal Black slab is illuminated and enlivened by a dense constellation of luminous glitter. The eye-catching surface adds sophisticated appeal to all interiors where it is included.

This slab, with irregular medium grain, creates surfaces with a texture covering areas in different shades of colour, extending over a light and luminous background. Ideal for facing and flooring, also in large interiors, and perfect for kitchen and bathroom counters.

This slab features a warm and elegant colour, with a fine uneven grain crossed by small light-coloured through veining. With its timeless charm, Ashen Light is perfect for use in both classic and contemporary contexts.

A light, bright background, illuminated by intermittent soft glimmers of light. The Blanc slab, the lightest in the Breeze collection, is for those who prefer a sober and composed style, but with a strong and distinctly contemporary character.

Ideal for modern interior design projects, the Hull quartz agglomerate slab has great visual appeal and a striking character. It allows us to be bold, playing with geometrical shapes, chiaroscuro contrasts and ambient light.

Unlike precious stone, a pearl does not come from the depths of the earth, but from the sea. Its creation is a rare event, and the surface we have given it reproduces the mystery of that intense living light, rich in reflections.

A vibrant surface in attractive warm colours, with a fine grain and small widespread veining, creating a refined and elegant texture to give a room character and uniqueness. Ideal for all types of kitchens, especially in a country and traditional style.

There is no single type of sand: its composition and colour depend on its rocks of origin. For the Sand slab, we have chosen a warm and compact shade, slightly veined by transparent glimmers of light that emerge on the surface.

Beige is subtle, graceful and elegant. This colour creates harmony, reflects light without exaggeration. It is perfect for any type of context as it expresses personality while being neutral. The colour we have created for the Cloudy collection of the same name represents and enhances all its aesthetic qualities.

The so-called Blue Stone of Belgium owes its name to its very special colour, a grey that acquires bluish shades when observed in full light. In this interpretation by Quartzforms®, the slab has a deep, intense colour, with a fine grain illuminated by bright, lighter opaline specks.

Black sometimes proves to be the brightest of colours because behind its abyss, it conceals a light that charms and allures. Like the Cloudy Black slab, dotted with a fine grain that gives it character and depth, bringing style to all kinds of interior.

As its name suggests, the Black and more surface stands out with its black background, dotted with a variable fine grain. This nocturnal and attractive texture perfectly blends with any style of interior design, from kitchen and bathroom counters to facing and flooring.

The sand of some deserts appears to be red due to the presence of specific minerals in its rocks of origin, whose colour is combined with that quartz. The Desert slab in the Cloudy collection is inspired by this ancient natural process.

Used since Roman times, Portland stone has a warm and luminous colour on which a fine grain emerges. Much loved in the English-speaking world, it covers the regal façade of Buckingham Palace. Portland Gray is a slab inspired by this centuries-old tradition.

There is optical white, very rarely found in nature, then there are countless shades of white in the world around us, like the many nuances of clouds. The White quartz agglomerate slab is inspired by this richness and depth of shades.
A white background and a very fine grain for Iceberg White, the quartz agglomerate slab that appears to have been created to bring new light to all interiors, in a contemporary or classic style.

As its name suggests, the Night Black surface stands out with its black background, highlighted by a grain of varying intensity. An attractive nocturnal texture is perfect for both glossy and brushed finishes, for every interior design use.

The bark of the birch tree stands out for its uniform whitish background scattered with irregular bluish-grey veins that branch out at its knots. An evocative and unmistakable pattern is created, which we have recreated in this elegant and versatile slab that brings new luminosity to all contexts.

Garrigue is the name given to wasteland that is home to low, thorny and inconspicuous vegetation that grows in grey-green patches interspersed with dry areas. When viewed from a panoramic perspective, an unexpected, fragmented and mimetic texture emerges rich in nuances and chiaroscuro effects. These are accompanied by areas of shade and flashes of light, which we have transformed into a decorative pattern.

The magnolia tree has lush foliage consisting of large shiny, leathery leaves that block sunrays and appear dark and impenetrable when viewed against the light. This image offered by nature has inspired a quartz agglomerate slab with an impressive depth, sporadically interrupted and illuminated by scattered light-coloured veins.

Majestic and ancient, the Sequoia stands out for its imposing trunk, engraved with deep vertical veins and warm, natural tones, crossed by more intense shades that enhance its depth. This silent strength gives rise to a mineral surface with a decisive and enveloping character, crossed by marked textures and layered shades that evoke solidity, balance, and timeless elegance.

Cork is obtained from an oak tree that is a quarter of a century old. It takes another nine years for a new layer of bark to form. This slow and patient work of nature has inspired a quartz agglomerate slab scattered with subtle warm veins of varying intensity.

Taj recalls the extraordinary quartzite of the Taj Mahal, with soft, luminous tones that seem suspended between light and matter. The delicate colour layers create a poetic, light effect, transforming surfaces into veritable suspended landscapes, capable of enveloping rooms in an aura of elegance and serenity.

Opaline and iridescent, Ammonite belongs to a small group of stones of fossil origin, which also includes amber and coral. In nature, we can find many different shades of colour. In the Quartzforms version, the background is deep beige dotted with a fine grain.

Slow erosion caused by the wind, rivers, the sea and ice leaves its mark on rocks that bear witness to the age-old action of the elements. The Fossil Jet slab brings an attractive fragment of primordial nature to the rooms in your home.

Mother-of-pearl, considered a precious and decorative material, fascinates us with its luminosity and milky colour, rich in iridescent reflections. Hence Nacre slabs from the Fossil collection create surfaces with irresistible appeal.

The surfaces of ocean depths are the result of the centuries-old sedimentation of everything the sea contains. The warm, saturated colour of Nautilus quartz agglomerate slabs is dotted with a fine grain, comprising darker flecks with unexpected glimmers of light.

Narrow through veining, combined with a scattered fine grain that creates an attractive sense of movement. The Seashell slab is inspired by the depth and mystery of sea beds, illuminated by a clear and distant light.

A surface with a liquid and opaline appearance, crossed by a subtle pattern of pronounced veining in an almost golden shade. Caramel is a slab with a classic, elegant and alluring appearance, conveying a feeling of warmth and harmony.

The ivory background is enlivened by distinct veining in the characteristic burgundy red shade, illuminated by occasional subtle glimmers of light. The Cherry Beige slab is a classic example of stone decoration, enhancing kitchen and bathroom counters, facing and flooring.

A dense network of widespread veining and flecks gives the Dolphin Gray slab its lively and dynamic look. Like the other surfaces in the Imperial collection, the classic imprint allows it to be included in contexts in contemporary style, adding warm and stylish appeal.

Each grain seems to tell a story, a journey through imaginary landscapes where white blends harmoniously with warm, precious touches. It is like a golden dawn spreading across a white canvas, creating an atmosphere of serenity and timeless beauty.

The Meringa slab is crossed by a dense network of variegated veining and flecks, adding warm appeal to the opaline background and offering an expressive and dynamic surface. Ideal for any design requirement, from kitchen counters to facing and flooring.

Statuary marble has always been appreciated for its lustre. In this Quartzforms® creation, the ivory white background is enlivened with distinct veining, with shades ranging from grey to beige. A versatile slab for kitchen and, bathroom counters, facing and flooring.

Lava stones originate from the gradual cooling of magma produced by a volcanic eruption. They therefore represent the outcome of one of the most evocative and powerful natural phenomena. Their dominant colour is black, which we find in the intense Lavic Black slab with its translucent glow.

Featuring medium-sized grain, with colours ranging from white to intense beige, Navajo is a contemporary reinterpretation of the classic Venetian “terrazzo”, a marble grit that has been back in vogue in recent years.

Medium grain and a variable colour, offering various shades with warm chromatic areas blending from beige to ochre. This texture is familiar to us, as it was very popular in residential buildings in the mid-20th century, now brought up to date by Quartzforms®.

Unlike the other slabs in the MA collection, neutral grey provides a softer and more nuanced colour contrast between the background shade and its medium grain. The outcome is a sober and elegant surface ideal for including in contexts based on classic harmony.

The opaline whiteness of the surface catches the eye and focuses on the colours and shapes of well-defined and clearly visible quartz grains. An expressive luminous slab, ideal for many uses, for classic kitchen counters, bathrooms and exclusive flooring and facing.

meta.texture: fine grain, widespread veins, long veins
meta.description: Madreterra Dune evokes the silence of landscapes shaped by the wind, where warm, mineral sand caresses natural forms. An enveloping, harmonious shade that brings a sense of calm, balance and refined elegance to any space.

Madreterra Isola evokes sandy coastlines where light dances across rock and sand, creating natural harmonies of depth and softness. Its warm, enveloping tones bring character to interiors, transforming surfaces into distinctive elements of contemporary, elegant, and refined design.

meta.texture: fine grain, long veins, widespread veins
meta.description: Like a ray of sunshine captured in stone, Luce radiates an ethereal brilliance. Pure and reflective, it gently illuminates spaces, restoring lightness and vitality to every surface. A shade that invites you to breathe in the material and perceive its light.

meta.texture: fine grain, long veins, widespread veins
meta.description: Madreterra Ombra is the voice of the earth in its raw state: an earthy, authentic and dense brown that conveys the material with sincerity and warmth. A shade that combines depth and harmony, offering a discreet yet extraordinarily elegant presence.

The green colour of Atlantis is dream-like and elusive: an ephemeral chromatic perception, evoking the luminous transparency of seawater. Scattered with tiny contrasting dots, it is crossed by fine light-coloured through veins that create subtle and delicate interlacings. A precious, elegant slab with distinct appeal.

meta.texture: fine grain, widespread veins, long veins
meta.description: A tribute to the legendary island of Avalon, symbol of magic and transformation, New Era Avalon represents a harmonious balance between creativity and respect for the environment. With a deep red background, recalling the power and mystery of the Arthurian myth, and white veins weaving like luminous trails across the surface, this slab becomes the star of any environment.

meta.texture: fine grain, widespread veins, long veins
meta.description: Delving into a mysterious world. Leaping into distant worlds which, on a black background rich in nuances all waiting to be interpreted, create paths, images and galaxies. Crono is a timeless slab, an idea of style that can transform and interpret any context with boldness, charm and character.

New Era Flamingo represents the pinnacle of elegance and sustainable innovation. With its delicate pink colour, enriched by subtle and refined veins, this slab evokes lightness and serenity, creating unique and distinctive environments. Flamingo's warm and enveloping shade blends perfectly into contemporary and sophisticated spaces, adding a touch of originality and sophistication.

A luminous marble background is enhanced by a pattern of elegant and striking golden veins. The Gold slab expresses refined classic elegance, giving interiors a distinctly decorative touch. A style that is both timeless and contemporary.

meta.texture: fine grain, long veins, widespread veins
meta.description: The essential elegance of soft, ethereal shades that merge into subtle interwoven veins in shades of grey. The Lasa surface evokes cosy sensations, and, with its warm yet neutral shades, is in perfect harmony with the sophisticated textured contexts into which it is placed.

A luminous touch of elegance. An intangible representation of textured sensations and impressions coming from afar, which become protagonists in highly appealing spaces. Mahal features sinuous pink nuances that glow due to gold undertones, for a sophisticated, shiny and original effect.

It is said that black and white are two extremes, between them lies an endless range of shades of grey. Mystic is the new interpretation of this concept: a slab expresses warmth, depth and style, as it has a texture that is a harmonious alternation of chiaroscuro effects.

The black of the Nirvana slab is alluring and mysterious, like a dark curtain that lets occasional flashes of light shine through: an invitation to exceed the limits of our perception. A contemporary, enigmatic and evocative surface embellishes a room with timeless elegance.

meta.texture: fine grain, widespread veins, long veins
meta.description: An interplay of balance with subtle shades, tending towards cool sensations without sacrificing impeccable neutrality, and bold streaks, aspiring to a certain geometrical quality yet remaining free and creative in essence. Poseidon is contemporary and bold, a slab that can be easily interpreted in any context.

meta.texture: fine grain, widespread veins, long veins
meta.description: Inspired by the deep tones of sienna, this surface features a rich brown background with delicate white and beige veins. white and beige veins. It evokes the timeless beauty of nature, with each vein telling a story of transformation. It combines sublime aesthetics with enduring appeal. Let your space reflect the essence of the earth.

meta.texture: fine grain, long veins, widespread veins
meta.description: Immerse yourself in the enchantment of a new dawn, where light and shadow dance together on an extraordinary surface. The luminous white of the background, criss-crossed by long, sinuous anthracite veins, is delicately enriched by warm nuances in shades of beige. This play of colours and textures blends elegantly, creating a visual balance that enchants and inspires.

The white colour of this deep, compact slab, brings unique luminosity to interiors. It is adorned with an elegant pattern of grey veins, alternately finer or thicker, that attract and capture our attention, like the lines created by waves on sand. This reflects the great mastery achieved by Quartzforms® in processing quartz agglomerate, interpreting nature and its gifts.

The luminous background of the Lagoon slab is crossed by an impressive pattern of fine grey-green veins. It recalls fine, classic style marbles, given a decorative, contemporary twist. Like all Quartzforms® slabs, it can be used to clad walls, floors and any other surface in rooms, bringing luminosity, elegance and uniqueness to every space.

Black, impenetrable and deep, the surface of Midnight slabs is illuminated by white through veins of varying thickness, from narrow to wide, tracing an undulating pattern of markings that evoke the age-old action of time. For projects inspired by formal elegance, ideal for contexts in a classic or a more contemporary style.

Fine dark red veins alternate with more fleeting ones in a delicate grey colour with golden shimmering effects. They create a refined texture that interrupts and embellishes the pearly white background, rich in depth. A skilful interpretation of natural stone, evoking classic Breccia Capraia marble, which architects and interior designers can use to enhance any type of context and make it unique.

In the optical sense, black absorbs all light emission. But in the case of the Pebble Black slab this is compensated for by the opaline brightness of the grain, which adorns and enlivens the surface, making it opulent and attractive.

Kitchen counters, bathroom shelves, facing and flooring made of the Pebble Cappuccino slab convey warmth and positive energy. The generous grain in a rich variety of shades provides an expressive and vibrant surface, for interior design based on comfort and hospitality.

Even the deepest and most intense grey becomes bright when enriched by a precious texture of small polychrome and translucent stones. The Dark Grey quartz agglomerate slab in the Pebble collection combines classicism and contemporary appeal, creating highly versatile applications.

Enigmatic and luminous, close yet shrouded in mystery, the Moon has always inspired human imagination. Blue Moon is dedicated to it: a pure white surface crossed by long cobalt-blue veins that flow with natural elegance, like reflections of light across the night sky. A refined balance of depth and brightness, capable of bringing a magnetic, contemporary and timeless appeal to any interior.

The luminous trail of Halley's comet cyclically cuts through outer space. The slab named after it was inspired by the anticipation of this event: deep black is crossed by a lightning line of veining that reflects light, surprises and lets us admire it. An unexpected expression of elegance.

The uniform veining of Honey Galaxy seems to show us an ideal horizon. They create refined surfaces with strong aesthetic appeal, ideal for both contemporary and classic spaces. A distinctive covering to enhance and make contexts unique.

Interstellar expanses are permeated with a subtle, light substance, the same one that creates stars. With their imperceptible veining, vibrant and expressive, Interstellar Cloud slabs offer surfaces with defined contours, reflecting ambient light and expanding our perception of space.

The planet named after the main god in classical mythology is associated with universal and positive ideals such as renewal and transformation. With its elegant veining, the Jupiter slab expresses these timeless values in a contemporary manner, becoming the centre of attention in all contexts.

Mars is crossed by a dense network of deep furrows, evidence of ancient geological events. This has inspired a slab with a deep and compact colour, with veining that offers an attractive magnetic pattern. Its surface evokes the energy expressed by the action of natural elements.

Mercury is small, elusive and mysterious, inspiring rich and complex imagery. The slab bearing its name evokes its appearance: a concrete and strong surface, featuring a tactile mixture and subtle lighter veining alternating with slightly fading spots.

Far away and unreachable, invisible to the naked eye, Neptune appears as a bluish, opaline sphere. We have dedicated a slab to Neptune. It has a deep and luminous surface, crossed by a darker veining pattern: a rational design, influenced by time and nature.

Pluto is a slab with a great personality, elegantly decorative and crossed by a subtle texture of thick veining, making the surface deep, dense and tactile. Used for facing and flooring, or for kitchen and bathroom counters, it adds elegance to any interior.

Saturn and its rings, whose origin is still unknown, has always inspired the collective imagination. The Saturn slab has a fine texture of through veining that makes its surface uniform and harmonious, ideal for many uses, from kitchen counters to bathrooms and exclusive facing and flooring.

Tempel, the exaltation of the umpteenth astral discovery. This unprecedented surface is pure and unique, a white background with straight anthracite and orange veins, the result of precise stratifications inspired by natural geological dynamics.

Venus, the morning star, is the only planet visible during the day: it is represented by a hand holding a mirror. The Venus quartz agglomerate slab, featuring subtle veining throughout its entire surface, expresses depth, solidity and lustre.

The grain of the Ash Grey quartz conglomerate slab adorns the ash background of the surface with a texture of fine tone-on-tone flecks. Elegant without exaggeration, discreet and luminous, and ideal for a huge variety of aesthetic and functional uses.

Although rare and therefore extremely prestigious, black marble can be found in nature, and is generally of volcanic origin. Quartzforms® proposes this marble with a tone-on-tone grain of different depths and crystalline glimmers of light unevenly scattered to illuminate the surface.

Especially appreciated by architects and interior designers who pay great attention to contemporary trends, grey elegantly blends with all styles of interior furnishing. Dark Grey, as the name suggests, is a particularly intense shade, with occasional and delicate glimmers of light.

In its many shades, beige is a timeless colour that is easy to match and always elegant. Surfaces made with the Light Beige slab make an interior warmer and more attractive, for details such as kitchen counters or for facing entire walls and floors.

The neutral grey background is enlivened by a profusion of tone-on-tone medium grain, with many inclusions of brighter flecks and an intermittent golden glow. The Light Grey slab represents style and is destined to become the protagonist of the spaces it inhabits.

Grey, the neutral colour par excellence, arises from the fusion of black and white and is a common colour of natural stone. Quartzforms® offers it in many shades; in the Light Grey version in the Qf collection, it is tactile and bright, enriched with an intense tone-on-tone grain.

Elegant and bright, white is one of the key colours of contemporary interior design, from minimalist to Scandinavian and industrial style. This stone surface in the Qf collection has a neutral colour, made natural and unique with its uniform fine grain in light shades.

This slab has a strong and distinct character also thanks to its deep black colour and its roughness, which recalls the appearance of natural charcoal. Spacco Black is ideal for contexts that require strong contrasts and a final effect intended to impress.

A vibrant-looking stone, a uniform milky-white background and a small translucent grain that creates a surface with modern yet timeless appeal. This slab is ideal for kitchen counters and islands with its strong and solid character.

Casanova, an icon of charm and audacity, is expressed in a light, luminous gray, enlivened by sparkles that capture the light. An elegant and discreet surface that whispers lightness and modernity, transforming every room into a refined tale of style and beauty.

Doge celebrates Venetian charm: an intense black illuminated by light fragments that sparkle like reflections on the night streets. A refined and enveloping surface that invites mystery and discreet luxury, transforming any space into a setting of elegance and charm.

Phoenix, symbol of rebirth and mystery, plays with the contrast between black and white. Dark fragments emerge like dancing shadows, narrating depth and character. The surface transforms the space into a theater of light and suggestion.

Goldoni evokes the warmth and lightness of Venetian comedies: an enveloping beige, illuminated by light fragments, that conveys balance and sophisticated harmony. Every detail reveals timeless elegance and conviviality.

Gritti, like the noble palaces that illuminated Venice, captures light with nobility and delicacy. Pure white is enlivened by light fragments that reflect harmony and refinement, transforming every surface into a luminous breath where history and matter meet.

Both nostalgic and contemporary, the Twinkle Black quartz agglomerate slab re-introduces a style that dominated furniture and architecture throughout much of the 20th century. Black medium grain on a dark background, with random bright and translucent flecks.

Countless shades of grey can be found in the surface of the Twinkle Grey slab, dotted by unexpected crystalline glimmers of light. A reassuring, evocative and nostalgic style, which surprises when skilfully included in rooms furnished with contemporary flair.

Perfect for use in contemporary or vintage style contexts, the Twinkle White slab adds personality and character to any room. Ideal for kitchen counters, for bathrooms, facing and flooring, even in large spaces.

Thanks to its strong colours and intense grain, marble from the African continent has been widespread throughout all ages. Quartzforms® proposes a dark version, featuring a bright pattern of small light points.

Just as Baroque art pursued a new balance of art and nature, so Quartzforms® creates surfaces that evoke natural stone despite being the result of innovative technological processes. Deep and intense Baroque quartz agglomerate slabs express this creative virtuosity.

The greatest protagonist of Baroque sculpture, Gian Lorenzo Bernini was a “poet of marble” who sculpted stone with his powerful creativity. To him, we have dedicated this luminous and evocative slab that adds a touch of classic refinement to any context.

Slabs of white marble were transformed into eternal and captivating neoclassical sculptures by the skilled hands of Antonio Canova. Thanks to Quartzforms® technology and research, a quartz agglomerate surface gives veining contemporary appeal and reproduces that perfect light.

This quartz surface perfectly expresses the uniqueness of natural stone, with a fine-grained and uniform brown background and widespread purple flecks with a powerful visual impact. This quartz is ideal for those who want a unique and original kitchen or bathroom counter.

The soft veining of Michelangelo slabs appears to emerge from the depth of stone. The quartz conglomerate reveals all its expressive power, enhancing surfaces in the kitchen, bathroom and all other rooms.
